notes:
Mascot moods, remarks, and full-screen manners

- Happy during a session; cross outside one (frown and an anime cross-mark), and every few
  minutes it says something disappointed but encouraging in a pixel speech bubble. It cheers when
  a session starts.
- Its feet now rest on top of the taskbar or Dock rather than sinking into it.
- Over a full-screen video (a media player, or a video site in a browser) it hides; over any
  other full-screen app it drops to the bottom of the screen, since the taskbar's hidden.
